speed.inference_note: MD-form route-B graph, RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, min of 3 x 25 evaluations, ms per evaluation; measured on same-graph reference files ref_N16 / ref_N32, not on the trained models

scans.note: Rigid centre-of-mass scans of charged pairs: fragment B shifted in 0.05 Å steps over 6–11 Å (101 points per scan; 11–14 Å from the 0.5 Å DFT grids). Sets: type-held-out pairs (K⁺Gdm⁺, Gdm⁺I⁻, Gdm⁺Mg²⁺; 6 orientations each), the set-B gate pairs (K⁺MeCN, NH₄⁺Cl⁻, NH₄⁺NH₄⁺; 6 each) and 3 orientations of four sign-set cells. AL is ONE seed (13, EMA): every AL number here is a screen. C0 and P are their seed-13 EMA files (H100), PET-OMol-S the base model (GGUF, fp32). Reference: wB97M-V/def2-TZVPD for the type-held-out and set-B scans; the sign-set cells and the two dense pair scans have no DFT, their reference is the point-charge Coulomb force k/d². Gdm⁺Mg²⁺ (multivalent) and the neutral H₂O·H₂O pair are shown apart and are in no aggregate (AGG). Intervals: 95 % percentile block bootstrap over whole scans (asymmetric); n = number of scans. Kink = largest second difference of the net force on B minus the DFT-spline second difference, in meV/Å per (0.05 Å)²; a smooth DFT curve gives about 6.

fig3_search_cells.caption: Sign-set cells (500 orientations per cell): right-sign share and median force over the Coulomb reference k/d².

fig4_fine_scans.caption: 0.05 Å scans through 6–11 Å: net force, model minus DFT, and the second difference (kinks).

fig5_dense_pairs_kinks.caption: Dense +1/+1 scans (0.002 Å, Coulomb reference) and kink size in 6–9 Å (median, 95 % CI).

ladder_large_n.note: Error of dE(n) = E[ion + n waters] - E[n waters] - E[ion] against the DFT reference law dE_inf + A q^2 k / 2R_n, n = 200-4,000 waters (to 12,001 atoms), 4 frames per n. Pass rule (DRAFT, ladder v2 A1; not frozen): the absolute error at n = 1,000 and at n = 4,000 is inside 2 x the law's fit uncertainty (Na⁺ 0.86 and 1.14 eV, Cl⁻ 1.09 and 1.36 eV); resolution about 1 eV. Slope = OLS over n = 1,000-4,000 (3 sizes x 4 frames) and the tail fit A over n >= 500 (DFT range [1.0, 2.0]) are diagnostics: a constant-offset model passes the slope rules for every offset up to 30 eV, and the DFT oracle itself passes the tail-A rule in only 57-65 % of draws. Per-file slope interval = 95 % percentile bootstrap over the 4 frames within each n (10,000 resamples); per-arm interval = 95 % t over seeds (4 seeds for AL and PAL; P and C0 have 2 seeds each, listed, no seed interval; those are screens). Na⁺ and Cl⁻ only; Mg²⁺ was not run at large n. The files hold the as-trained model only, so there is no LES-off ladder. EMA final files; same reference and analysis for every arm. The reference law is a fit to DFT clusters up to 192 waters, extrapolated to 12,001 atoms. A slope is fitted to the matched (XW, W) frame pairs present: where a run ended before its last frames (PAL seeds 13-15, Cl⁻ at n = 4,000, no failed evaluations) the slope uses fewer frames at that n, and the table gives the frames per n used.

typeheld_pdiff_text: P − C0, gate-band force MAE over 4 independent seeds (13r, 14, 15, 16; 95 % t): without Mg²⁺ -3.74 [-6.43, -1.04] meV/Å, with Mg²⁺ -3.76 [-10.28, +2.76] meV/Å. Without Mg²⁺ the result rests on Gdm⁺I⁻ (-5.82 [-10.03, -1.60]), and halide analogues of that pair are in P's training rows; K⁺Gdm⁺ alone is -1.66 [-5.71, +2.39], an interval that includes zero.
evidence_limits: Seeds and structures are different intervals. A claim needs 4 seeds and uses a 95 % t interval over seeds; bootstrap intervals over frames or scans describe one file and are narrower. The H100 seed-13 files are replicates of GH200 seed 13r and are never counted as a fifth seed.

Thresholds are conventions of the program, not physical bounds: the ±0.02 eV/water small-n ladder slope and the 0.2 e ion-shell limit. The large-n ladder no longer uses a slope rule: its draft limit (ladder v2, not frozen) is an absolute error of 0.86 / 1.14 eV (Na⁺) and 1.09 / 1.36 eV (Cl⁻) at n = 1,000 / 4,000 waters, 2 x the DFT law's fit uncertainty, with a resolution of about 1 eV.

Multivalent systems (|q| ≥ 2, Mg²⁺) are excluded from every score by default and shown apart; the switch includes them. P − C0, gate-band force MAE over 4 independent seeds (13r, 14, 15, 16; 95 % t): without Mg²⁺ -3.74 [-6.43, -1.04] meV/Å, with Mg²⁺ -3.76 [-10.28, +2.76] meV/Å. Without Mg²⁺ the result rests on Gdm⁺I⁻ (-5.82 [-10.03, -1.60]), and halide analogues of that pair are in P's training rows; K⁺Gdm⁺ alone is -1.66 [-5.71, +2.39], an interval that includes zero.
Every arm is a fine-tune of the same pretrained PET-OMol-S; a 'seed' is a different data order and initialisation of the new parameters, not an independent pre-training.

P's seam and pairs-gate gains are in-distribution: P's band-prior rows are labelled with the fixed ESP-charge Coulomb oracle that the seam metrics also use (not DFT), and the pairs gate and the lrbench dimer set use the same 24 monomers as P's rows.

The lrbench dimer set is not an external test for our arms: its monomers are our set-B monomers (identical to 1e-6 Å), and 1,042 of its 1,254 frames are pair types in P's training rows (456 are set-B train types of every route-B arm). On it P also loses the partial ion + polar tail (ε −0.241 [−0.275, −0.206]), and AL/PAL show a like-charge overshoot (ε +0.234 to +0.258, 4 of 4 seeds) and a spurious ion + nonpolar tail.

AL and PAL fail the draft absolute-error limit of the large-n ladder in all 4 of 4 seeds, for both ions: the error is +12 to +17 eV (Na⁺) and -10 to -15 eV (Cl⁻) at n = 1,000 and 17–31 eV in size at 4,000 waters, against limits of 0.9–1.4 eV. Their small slopes (inside ±0.01 eV/water) are not a pass: a constant-offset model passes the slope rules for every offset up to 30 eV (an arm with constant offsets, SB_K1, did).

EMA: in the C0H run EMA lowers the val500 force error by 0.81 [0.16, 1.46] meV/Å but raises the energy error by +0.20 [0.03, 0.36] meV/atom; with the lr annealed, EMA and raw weights agree within ±0.2 meV/Å. C0H against C0 changes the schedule as well, so it is not an EMA test.

Builds and hardware differ between some compared files (training on H100 or GH200, scoring on different builds); every comparison here pairs files scored by the same chain unless a row says otherwise.

The adversarial sets (seam search set, sign-set cells) were designed after earlier failures were seen, so they are not blind tests, and a pass of rule 4 (the sign set) does not show that orientation behaviour holds on other cells; ladder v2 (draft, A2) adds an orientation development set from non-sealed data and an orientation-consistency rung (B9). The type-held-out gate is the only pair set no arm had seen by type in its fine-tune and charge-model rows; it was not checked against the OMol25 pretraining.

running.name: AL four-seed repeat (seeds 14, 15, 16)

running.result: AL, 4 seeds (13-16, EMA; claim level), scored without Mg²⁺: val500 force MAE 39.98 [39.66, 40.31] meV/Å, inside the 42.0 limit. Held-out ladder slopes (LES on, eV/water, limit ±0.02): Na⁺ +0.0241 [+0.0207, +0.0274] fails; Cl⁻ -0.0192 [-0.0249, -0.0134], whose interval crosses the limit, so it fails as written. Na⁺ shell error per seed 0.185, 0.211, 0.259, 0.208 e against 0.2 e: above the limit in 3 of 4 seeds. Sign-set cells passing per seed: 3/2/3/3 of 4. Verdict: AL is not the lead candidate (Mg²⁺ apart: Mg²⁺ slope +0.0427 [+0.0392, +0.0461], not scored).

running.name: PAL (P's band-prior rows + AL recipe, seeds 13-16)
running.what: P's data5p charged-pair rows trained with AL's recipe. Pre-registered 'adds up' reading: PAL within P's 4-seed spread on the NH₄⁺Gdm⁺ 7.5 Å overshoot and the Gdm⁺Gdm⁺ LES-off dmin rms, within AL's spread on the Na⁺/Cl⁻ ladder slopes, val500 upper 95 % ≤ 42.0 meV/Å, ion shells ≤ 0.2 e.
running.result: PAL, 4 seeds (13-16, EMA), scored without Mg²⁺: the seam gain of P is kept (in-distribution: P's band-prior rows are labelled with the fixed ESP-charge Coulomb oracle that the seam metrics also use, not DFT). NH₄⁺Gdm⁺ 7.5 Å |overshoot − 1| 0.207 [0.083, 0.332] against P 1.19 ± 0.60 (sd); Gdm⁺Gdm⁺ LES-off dmin rms 0.182 [0.158, 0.206] eV/Å against P 0.352 ± 0.086. val500 force MAE 40.05 [39.63, 40.46] meV/Å, inside 42.0. Held-out ladder slopes (LES on, eV/water): Na⁺ +0.0249 against AL +0.0241, Cl⁻ -0.0198 against AL −0.0192. Na⁺ shell error per seed 0.221, 0.226, 0.247, 0.212 e: above 0.2 e in every seed, so the shell test fails. Pre-registered reading: seam kept True, slopes kept True (within AL's seed spread on all 8 Na⁺/Cl⁻ tests; PAL's slopes are not better than AL's, and both miss ±0.02), val500 True, shells False. Verdict: PAL does not add up, on the shell test only, with and without Mg²⁺.
